parsed.rationale: Both participating records live in test files: one at 'Shared/Metadata/Tests/MetadataTests/DiscogsMarkupParserTests.swift' (package: Metadata) and the other at 'WXYC/iOS/Tests/WXYCTests/DiscogsFormatterTests.swift' (package: app:iOS). Although neither record carries is_test=true in its context_flags, both file paths are unambiguously under test directories ('Tests/MetadataTests' and 'Tests/WXYCTests'), and the type name 'MockDiscogsEntityResolver' is a test-fixture mock by naming convention. Lifting this type into shared production code would couple test-fixture semantics into a production or shared package, which is the canonical restraint pattern. Each test target legitimately owns its own local mock to avoid cross-test-target coupling.
